ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a contour topographic map of a certain place in northern Hebei; the legend includes elements such as residential areas, small cement plants, quarries, places of historic interest and scenic beauty, and traffic lines. The four small cement plants on the map are respectively marked as Jia, Yi, Bing, and Ding. Residential areas are mainly concentrated in the lower part and upper-left part of the figure; the traffic line runs across the figure and is connected with the outside; quarries are distributed near some mountainous areas. Plant Ding is located in the somewhat upper-middle part of the figure, with a quarry nearby, and is close to a traffic line; by comparison, some of the other plants are closer to residential areas or places of historic interest and scenic beauty, and some have raw material or traffic conditions inferior to Ding. Then reason: The raw materials of small cement plants mainly come from quarries, and the products are mainly transported outward, so priority should be given to selecting a location close to a quarry and convenient for outward transport; in environmental improvement, residential areas and places of historic interest and scenic beauty should also be avoided as much as possible, to reduce pollution impact. Comparing the four plants comprehensively, Plant Ding at the same time has the advantages of being close to the raw material place, having relatively convenient traffic, and having a relatively small impact on residential areas and sensitive scenic spots, so Plant Ding should be retained.

method.method_draft: 先读图例和图面：识别四座小水泥厂的位置，识别采石场、居民点、名胜古迹、公路或铁路等交通线以及等高线地形。再结合题干“原料主要来自采石场，产品主要外运”，按工业区位综合评价：应优先保留距离采石场近、靠近主要交通线、外运方便，同时远离居民点和名胜古迹、对环境影响较小的厂。逐一比较四厂，丁厂附近有采石场和交通线，外运条件较好，且相对远离主要居民点和敏感景点；其他厂或靠近居民点、景区，或交通/原料条件较差。因此应保留丁。

Then reason: The raw materials of small cement plants mainly come from quarries, and the products are mainly transported outward, so priority should be given to selecting a location close to a quarry and convenient for outward transport; in environmental improvement, residential areas and places of historic interest and scenic beauty should also be avoided as much as possible, to reduce pollution impact. Comparing the four plants comprehensively, Plant Ding at the same time has the advantages of being close to the raw material place, having relatively convenient traffic, and having a relatively small impact on residential areas and sensitive scenic spots, so Plant Ding should be retained.
